parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). The two methods are distinct mock stubs that resolve different entity types (artist vs. master), so their structural similarity is a natural consequence of implementing the same mock interface for different test scenarios rather than a sign of unintended duplication. Collapsing them into a single generic function would conflate unrelated test concerns and reduce test-fixture clarity.
